day_overview.title: The Day
day_overview.brief: One day. Three distinct worlds. Each designed to feel complete — together, they tell one story.

phases.title: The Ceremony
phases.description: White florals in green, ivory & champagne · sculpted floral arch · semicircle seating for 200 · vows · first kiss under coloured smoke

phases.title: Cocktail Hour
phases.description: Ivory lounge furniture · draped cabanas · white outdoor bar · champagne & canapés · portrait corridor opens

phases.title: The Reception
phases.description: Crystal chandeliers · blush & rose ceiling florals · monogram floor · sweetheart stage · dinner · first dance on clouds

arrival.title: Arrival & Welcome
arrival.brief: From the car park, guests are welcomed on both sides. One face reads WELCOME — the other tells the story of O & T, chapter by chapter, lit from above, florals at the base.

images.caption: The story of us — other side

design_brief.heading: The Design Brief
design_brief.body:
Tall uplit ivory panels · serif caps + italic script typography · white hydrangea at the base

Welcome side — individual letter panels, bold serif WELCOME with italic "to our wedding" beneath

Story side — each panel is a chapter of O & T with a couple photograph and handwritten-style narrative text

ceremony.title: The Setting
ceremony.brief: Outdoors, under open sky. White florals in green, ivory and champagne — not a petal of blush in sight. The ceremony palette is classical and restrained so the reception reveal lands as a full colour transformation.

images.caption: The arch & aisle · white florals · green, ivory & champagne

approach.label: The Approach
approach.body: Lean into Siyekhya Estate's existing architecture and nature. The columns, stonework, mature trees and garden greenery set the scene — florals are the enhancement, placed to frame and soften what is already there, never to cover or compete with it.

notes.label: The Arch
notes.body: Sculpted ivory arch dressed with an asymmetric cascade of white florals — a mix of silk and fresh blooms — with green foliage, ivory and champagne tones and soft baby's breath. Ivory urns of white florals flank the entrance.

notes.label: The Aisle
notes.body: White floral runners flanking a marble runner. All-white blooms with green foliage.

notes.label: Seating
notes.body: Semicircle layout wrapping guests around the moment — no one cranes, every seat is close.

first_kiss.label: The First Kiss
first_kiss.body: At the first kiss, coloured smoke cannons release behind the arch — blush, champagne, dusty rose and ivory blooming into the sky. The photographs will be extraordinary.

cocktail.title: Lounge & Bar
cocktail.brief: While the couple photographs, guests spill onto the garden lawn. Ivory lounge furniture clusters under draped cabanas and along the glass-roofed terrace. A white outdoor bar is fully stocked. Champagne is poured. The portrait corridor begins to draw people in.

looks.title: The Looks
looks.brief: Two versions of the bride. Two versions of the groom. The same couple, transformed twice across a single day.

entryway.title: The Entryway
entryway.brief: As guests move from cocktail hour into the reception, they walk through a portrait corridor where couple photographs alternate with table name panels — finding their table as they move through the story. At the corridor's end, a welcome board greets them into the room. Place cards at each table guide guests to their seat.

images.caption: Portrait gallery corridor · alternating story & table panels
Welcome board · end of the corridor

notes.label: The Corridor
notes.body: Large-format couple photographs alternating with table name panels along both walls. White hydrangea and baby's breath at the base of every frame. Uplighting from below. Guests arrive at the room already knowing where they belong.

notes.label: Welcome & Place Cards
notes.body: At the corridor end: couple portrait and "Welcome to the wedding of Onesimus & Taonanyasha." At each table, individual place cards guide guests to their seat.

reception.title: The Room
reception.brief: The ceremony was white, green, ivory and champagne. The reception room is the payoff — blush, dusty rose and champagne blooms cascading from the ceiling, crystal chandeliers, and a monogram floor that bears your names in gold.
room_notes: Hanging floral ceiling in blush, dusty rose & champagne
Ivory draped walls and tent lining
Antique gold O & T monogram dance floor
reception.sweetheart_note: Bridal party at a long banquet table for dinner. After the meal, O & T move to the sculptural couple's couch — raised platform, white arch backdrop, gold monogram centre, couple portraits either side. The dance floor opens in front of them.

images.caption: Sweetheart stage · O & T monogram · couple couch
Monogram floor · O & T · 7 April 2027 · antique gold

tables.title: The Tables
tables.brief: 200 guests — but the room should feel like a gathering, not a ballroom. Tables are clustered and connected, not lined in rows. Every seat has a sightline to the dance floor. Intimacy is a design choice.

images.caption: Layout inspiration · flex the table styles

note.label: Layout, not decor
note.body: Take the layout from this picture — flex the table styles across the room with a mix of rounds, long banquets and curved serpentine runs, clustered rather than in rows. The level of decor is the one shown in the table setting picture alongside: ivory linen, tall florals and taper candles.

notes.label: Centrepieces

notes.label: Layout
notes.body: Mix of round & long banquet tables · ivory linen · bridal party at long front table · place cards at every setting

cake.title: The Cake
cake.brief: The centrepiece dessert on a dual revolving stand — slowly turning so every guest sees it. Ivory tiers, a cascade of 3D sugar flowers, and a gold O & T monogram at the crown.
